C08-M03-L06-F1.title: Query thinking: from question to recorded evidence
C08-M03-L06-F1.caption: An investigative search moves from a written question through time range, filter, inspection, aggregation and pivot to a recorded result, then loops on the next entity.
C08-M03-L06-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of seven steps: Question (what else did WS-104 do?); Time range first (window around the known events); Filter (source and normalised fields); Inspect raw events (check fields, case, nulls); Aggregate (count, distinct, first and last seen, stack); Pivot on an entity (a value becomes the next filter); Record query + result (range, time run, output). A feedback arrow from the last step back to the first is labelled new entity: new question.

nodes.label: Pivot on an entity
nodes.sub: a value becomes the next filter

C08-M03-L06-F1.note: Inspect before you aggregate: a summary of broken data looks as tidy as a summary of good data.
